signatureDish.name: Rendang Wagyu Premium
signatureDish.subtitle: Signature Collection
signatureDish.description: Tender Australian Wagyu beef slow-cooked for 8 hours in a rich blend of 23 aromatic spices. A culinary masterpiece that honors centuries of Minangkabau tradition.

about.heading: A Story of Passion
about.story: Founded in 2018 by Chef Arief Santoso, Nusantara Dining was born from a singular vision: to elevate Indonesian cuisine to its rightful place among the world's great culinary traditions.
about.mission: We believe that every dish tells a story — of the farmers who grew the ingredients, the generations who perfected the recipes, and the artisans who bring it all to life in our kitchen.
